description: A cinematic movie-streaming app (CineStream) with a dark, poster-driven UI on the Uno Simple theme and an iOS-style floating capsule TabBar shell. Onboarding carousel, a Browse home (featured hero, category filter chips, Trending and New Arrivals rails), a Search page (live query + genre filter with a derived results list), a Social Feed of friend activity, a Profile with a live watchlist count and grouped settings, a rich Movie Detail (hero, cast, scores, reviews, related — a full-screen page on phone/tablet and a modal on desktop) and a Playback screen. Every movie card opens its detail; a shared watchlist service and MVUX state make the filters and 'My List' toggle actually work. Runs responsively on desktop and mobile.

I've modernized the Uno Platform app at MovieStreamApp/MovieStreamApp.csproj.

**Structure:**
- A Shell (UserControl) hosts a utu:ExtendedSplashScreen and is the navigation root. MainPage is the tab shell: an iOS-26-style floating capsule utu:TabBar (Themes/FloatingTabBar.xaml, built on the Simple theme) centred over a visibility-based content region, with tabs Browse, Search, Friends (SocialFeed) and Profile. Onboarding, Playback and the Movie Detail are full-screen shell SIBLINGS (not tab routes) navigated to on demand; the Movie Detail is a full-screen Page on phone/tablet and a centred ContentDialog modal on desktop (two DataViewMaps -> one MovieDetailModel, chosen by width with {utu:Responsive}). Detail/Playback receive the tapped Movie via DataViewMap nav-data.
- Domain records live in Presentation/SharedTypes.cs (Movie has a [property: Key] Id); one shared MovieData catalogue seeds every page and is keyed by id, so a card resolves the full entity to open its detail. Images are specific remote pexels photos (no bundled Content assets, no random placeholder seeds).
- Page models are MVUX records. Interactive pages are reactive: Browse's category chips and Search's query + genre tiles are IState with derived IListFeed results, and a DI-singleton WatchlistService (IListState<Movie>) backs the 'My List' toggle shared across Browse, Movie Detail and the Profile count. Purely static pages (SocialFeed, Onboarding, Playback) opt out with [ReactiveBindable(false)].
- Every icon is vector PathIcon/Path geometry resolved through a shared Icon converter (Fluent UI System Icons), never FontIcon glyphs, so icons render on every target and in the design host. Rounded image tiles are Border+ImageBrush so they clip to the corner radius. Rails use ItemsRepeater + UniformGridLayout and every page caps its content width for desktop.
- Runs on the Uno Simple theme (SimpleToolkitTheme) with the CineStream brand mapped onto semantic role colors in ThemeColors.xaml; the styling vocabulary is in Styles.xaml (merged last). Body text is the framework Roboto. Branded app icon + splash via Uno.Resizetizer.
- Navigation uses Uno.Extensions.Navigation with routes registered in App.xaml.cs.

The app builds and runs on iOS, Android, WebAssembly and desktop. The user may ask me to modify it.
